# unleash_feature (Data Source)

Fetch a feature flag, including whether it is enabled in each environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unleash_feature" "maintenance_mode" {
  name    = "ops.maintenance-mode"
  project = "default"
}

# Use the flag's state in production to decide whether to provision something
resource "null_resource" "maintenance_page" {
  count = data.unleash_feature.maintenance_mode.environments["production"] ? 1 : 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the feature flag.

### Optional

- `project` (String) The project the feature flag belongs to. Defaults to `default`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the feature flag.
- `environments` (Map of Boolean) Whether the flag is enabled, keyed by environment name. For example, `data.unleash_feature.example.environments["production"]`.
- `id` (String) The name of the feature flag.
- `impression_data` (Boolean) Whether impression data is emitted for this flag.
- `stale` (Boolean) Whether the flag is marked as stale.
- `type` (String) The type of the feature flag.
